task_description: Reproduce the Mwanza SECONDARY-school Form Two mock reports (7 council/district-level + 12 region-level PDFs) as self-contained HTML+CSS -> WeasyPrint PDF generators, each with its own template, CSS, JSON data (display strings) and reference PDF, organized by school level (secondary now, primary future placeholder) and scope (council, region). Reuse the proven pattern from the existing lakezone success example (kept intact) and the compare.py fidelity harness as the verdict: generated PDFs must match originals (same rows, same colours, same fonts, same everything). Templates are named by LEVEL+FUNCTION (not the test council/region instance names) and are data-driven so any future data of the same shape renders through them. Use real fonts with no fallback chains.

verification.summary: scripts/build_all.py renders + compares all 16 report dirs (17 comparisons incl. dual-source region-schools-rank-subjectwise) with '=== build-all OK ==='. Every generated PDF matches its original's page count EXACTLY. No report falls back to Noto - all embed the real Liberation/Arial-family faces. Reports are FULLY self-contained: the orphaned reports/_shared/fonts.css was DELETED (nothing imported it) and every style.css carries its own inline @font-face, single family name, no fallback, no @import. LAKEZONE success example RESTORED: reference/original.pdf recovered from origin/main and re-compared (0 words missing/extra on all 11 pages, ~5-7% tolerant diff), and scripts/compare.py's tolerant (1px-shift) diff column was restored from origin/main so all scores use the same ruler that grades lakezone. FILL PALETTE (review v1 issues 3-4) FIXED: region-schools-rank-overall, council-schools-rank-overall and region-schools-rank-governments now reproduce the original's FIXED per-division pastel column tints (measured with pdfplumber fills()); on their repeating main-grid pages compare.py reports ZERO fills-only-in-original AND ZERO fills-only-in-generated (previously ~38 orig-only + competency-colour bleed). region-mobility now reproduces the fixed section/group-header fills and the IMEPANDA/UMESHUKA up-down row colour-coding (a FIXED mapping keyed off the hali value, plus signed MJONGEO ink) - fills-only-in-generated is now '-' on every page. Only the competency-level background remains data-driven (grading.py); every other fill is a fixed palette entry. HONEST RESIDUALS: (1) the three division grids and mobility still sit at ~33-41% pixel-diff because of Liberation-vs-Arial glyph-edge noise plus a small constant ~2-3pt vertical row-offset that cannot be removed without breaking the exact rows-per-page pagination; (2) 'fills only in original' still appears on the one-off SUMMARY PERFORMANCE decorative banner (rendered once per report) and as region-mobility's #c00000 negative-delta ink (rendered as coloured text; pdfplumber counts the original's as a filled glyph path). These are documented in reports/secondary/INDEX.md and reports/README.md. Verdict measured by scripts/compare.py per-report; per-page scores in each output/comparison*/README.md and consolidated in reports/secondary/INDEX.md.
